name: OCR
recent: OCR Group 近期主要涉及一宗重大诉讼，吉隆坡高等法院裁定 O&C Makok Isola 对 Kumpulan Jetson 及其子公司的索赔成立，并获判利息与堂费。此外，公司截至 2026 年 6 月 30 日止季度营收同比增 35.3%，但净亏损 238.6 万令吉，亏损较上季扩大。
notable: 吉隆坡高等法院裁定 O&C Makok Isola 对 Kumpulan Jetson 及其子公司的索赔成立，并获判利息与堂费。
risks: 公司涉及重大诉讼，法院已作出裁决。
截至 2026 年 6 月 30 日止季度净亏损 238.6 万令吉，亏损较上季扩大。
earnings: 截至 2026 年 6 月 30 日止季度，营收为 5,806.5 万令吉，同比增 35.3%，环比减 14.6%；净亏损 238.6 万令吉，净利率 -4.1%，上季为 -0.6%。

recent_en: OCR Group is recently involved in a material litigation where the Kuala Lumpur High Court allowed O&C Makok Isola's claims against Kumpulan Jetson and its subsidiary, with interest and costs. Separately, for the quarter ended 30 June 2026, revenue rose 35.3% year-on-year but the company recorded a net loss of MYR 2.386 million, widening from the previous quarter.
notable_en: The Kuala Lumpur High Court allowed O&C Makok Isola's claims against Kumpulan Jetson and its subsidiary, with interest and costs awarded.
risks_en: The company is involved in material litigation, and the court has ruled on the matter.
Net loss for the quarter ended 30 June 2026 was MYR 2.386 million, widening from the previous quarter.
earnings_en: For the quarter ended 30 June 2026, revenue was MYR 58.065 million, up 35.3% year-on-year and down 14.6% quarter-on-quarter; net loss was MYR 2.386 million with a net margin of -4.1%, versus -0.6% in the previous quarter.
